entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have this helmet I bought a while ago, and I need to... I think, return it? I'm a bit confused about how this works.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF789012.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Trail Helmet right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. It's not broken or anything. The box is still unopened. I just... I think it's the color. It's not what I expected and I'm worried about my safety if it's not the right gear for me. The website was so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I completely understand wanting to feel confident in your gear. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.

Alright, Sarah. I see here that you received the helmet 73 days ago. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm generating a prepaid return label and I'll email it to you in the next few minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
